heading: VI. 26.
paragraphs: [2295] Basil., De Bapt., bk. i. ch. 12.
[2301] Text, ep' aphtharsian. Variant, ep' aphtharsi& 139;; old interpretation, in incorruption.'
[2309] Text, kathairetai. Variant in many Codices is ekathaireto. On one margin is, e ekekatharto.
[2312] Text, photismos, illumination. In R. 2626 is added, kai hagiasmos, which Faber translates, "et illuminatio et sanctificatio." In R. 2924, hagiasmos is read instead of photismos.
[2315] Greg. Naz., Orat. 40; Athan. ad Serap. De Spir. Sancto.
[2320] Greg., Orat. 40; Basil, Hom. de Bapt.; Chrys. in Matt. Hom. 10, and others.
[2329] Text, hoslian...hoson. Variants, hoson and ho kai.
[2331] See Basil, De Spir. Sanct., c. 13.
[2332] ou soterion, alla tes men kakias anairetikon ouk eti gar kakia kai hamartia politeuetai; kolazon de ateleuteta.
[2336] Cf., Allab., De Cousens, bk. iii., c. 16; Cyril of Jerus., Catech. Myst. 2.
